'''D-R3D''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[Dread Masters]] as a member of their defensive unit but was subsequently repaired and reprogrammed by the [[Eternal Alliance]] for offensive, defensive and medical uses.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
D-R3D appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a Cartel Market companion, added with Patch 5.7.<ref name="SWTOR" />
